scope: Prompt04 platform API old-Python contract delta audit versus Rust/PostgreSQL production-safe implementation.

global_followups.detail: Rust retry now consumes the Idempotency-Key header, but still requires request.reason. Old Python tests allow POST /api/background-jobs/{job_id}/retry with an empty JSON body for supported job types.
global_followups.required_next_action: Make reason optional for retry or document an approved replacement contract before adding retry to platform runtime shadow scope.

global_followups.detail: Old Python settings write synchronously calls OARoleSyncService.sync_access_control and rolls it back on persistence failure. Rust stores versioned PostgreSQL settings facts with audit/idempotency but does not synchronously provision OA roles.
global_followups.decision_question: Should OA role sync remain part of POST /api/workbench/settings, or move to an async identity/role provisioning workflow?
global_followups.recommended_decision: Move OA role provisioning to an audited async task/outbox workflow; keep settings write as PostgreSQL fact persistence plus read-model invalidation, and expose role-provisioning health separately.

global_followups.detail: API request path is intentionally queue-only. Prompt04 runtime shadow proves request contract equivalence, but destructive worker execution still requires separate staging worker proof, approval evidence, backup evidence, and rollback/PITR drill before production cutover.

legacy_python_behavior.direct_endpoint: POST /api/workbench/settings/data-reset validates admin/OA password and historically executed SettingsDataResetService.execute in the API process.
legacy_python_behavior.job_endpoint: POST /api/workbench/settings/data-reset/jobs created a background job envelope in the Python process; old tests cover queryable job shape and no password leakage.

rust_behavior.direct_endpoint: POST /api/workbench/settings/data-reset returns 202 and queues a settings_data_reset worker task/outbox command.
rust_behavior.job_endpoint: POST /api/workbench/settings/data-reset/jobs also returns 202 queued job envelope and records data reset request lineage.

architecture_approval: docs/architecture/backend-refactor/remaining-api-contracts.md route 8: direct execution is not production-safe; API caller receives queued job unless worker-maintenance context is used.
docs/architecture/backend-refactor/remaining-api-contracts.md Prompt04 delta note for data reset queue-only behavior.
cutover_required_evidence: approval_id source of truth and retention policy
backup_evidence_id linked to a restorable backup/PITR point
staging worker execution proof for each destructive reset action
rollback/PITR drill evidence after worker failure and partial completion
audit event and data_reset_requests lineage query evidence
operator runbook for queued/running/cancelled/failed reset jobs
data_reset_decision.prohibited_change: Do not restore synchronous destructive reset in the API request path.

comparison.request_fields: Path job_id; optional reason/idempotency. Rust requires idempotency through body/header for write safety.
comparison.response_fields: Both expose legacy {job} envelope in runtime shadow.
comparison.http_status: 200 on visible acknowledgement; 401/403 auth failure; 404 not found/invisible.
comparison.side_effects: Python marks visible job acknowledged; Rust writes acknowledgement fact without mutating core worker task status.
comparison.audit_idempotency: Rust records audit/idempotency; Python service is in-process state-store based.

endpoints.required_next_action: No Prompt04 code action. Keep core worker status separate from notification acknowledgement.

comparison.request_fields: Old Python accepts an empty JSON body for supported retry paths; Rust now accepts Idempotency-Key header but still requires reason.
comparison.response_fields: Old Python returns a legacy {job} replacement/retry envelope; Rust returns task/outbox command metadata.
comparison.http_status: Python supported retry returns 202; Rust route returns 202 only after reason/idempotency validation.
comparison.permission_failure: Covered by general auth middleware; not in the 16 Prompt04 runtime fixture endpoints.
comparison.side_effects: Both should avoid replaying side effects in the request path; Rust correctly queues task/outbox.
comparison.audit_idempotency: Rust has actor/trace/idempotency; Python retry path is background-job-service based.

endpoints.required_next_action: Make reason optional and add retry to runtime shadow scope, or document an approved replacement contract.

comparison.request_fields: Both validate settings arrays/maps; Rust additionally requires idempotency and versioned fact write semantics.
comparison.response_fields: Runtime shadow verifies compatible settings payload for Prompt04 fixture.
comparison.http_status: Runtime shadow status is GO; old Python has explicit 502 oa_role_sync_failed and 503 app_settings_persistence_failed branches.
comparison.side_effects: Old Python synchronously syncs OA roles, invalidates workbench read models and clears search cache. Rust writes PostgreSQL settings facts/audit/idempotency; role provisioning is not synchronous.
comparison.audit_idempotency: Rust production path is stronger; Python old path has app-state persistence and role-sync rollback semantics.

endpoints.recommended_decision: Move OA role sync to async task/outbox with separate health and retry visibility.
endpoints.required_next_action: Product/ops decision required before final cutover contract is frozen for role provisioning side effects.
